rules: Every person here was read on a PRIMARY source: the employer's own site, their own press release, their own blog byline, or the person's own GitHub profile.
Aggregator and scraper sites (RocketReach, ZoomInfo, Comparably, Apollo, Lusha) are not accepted as evidence of current employment. Names found only there are left out.

A 'profile' field is only ever a URL the person published themselves somewhere public. A LinkedIn slug is NEVER guessed from a name: a wrong guess is either a 404 or, far worse, a stranger presented as the hiring manager.
With no published profile, the page links a LinkedIn search scoped to the person's name and employer instead. That resolves to the real profile in one click and invents nothing.
'why' says what the person is to this req. It is a judgement, not a fact, and it is worded as one.

people.name: Mat Velloso
people.title: Chief Product Officer, Docker
people.note: Appointed 2026-08-18, three weeks before this Senior Director, Product Management req was published on 2026-09-09. A new CPO building his own org is the person a product leadership hire reports to. Background per Docker's release: 15 years at Microsoft including advisor to the CTO then the CEO, then developer growth for Google AI Studio, then API strategy for Meta's AI models.
